description: Eight-step voltage sequencer in which any step can be switched out of the run, by its own button or by a trigger

params.text: Sets the voltage for this step, -1 to +1 multiplied by the range chosen on the menu
Switches this step into and out of the run; a step that is off is passed over by the clock

inputs.text: The clock; a rising edge moves the sequence on to the next step that is switched on
A rising edge switches all eight steps back on and returns the sequence to the first step
A rising edge switches this step on if it was off and off if it was on

outputs.text: The voltage of the step the sequence has reached

notes: with every step switched off the sequence stays on the step it reached and keeps putting out that step's voltage.
the reset input switches all eight steps back on as well as returning to the first step, which nothing on the panel says.
menu: Range: -1v...1v, -2v...2v, -3v...3v, -5v...5v — sets the voltage the step knobs span
